title: For Such A Time As This

request.style: English, soft female solo voice, gentle piano, warm cello, light harp, acoustic guitar, hopeful and gentle mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Esther called Hathach to her side
One of the eunuchs assigned to serve
She ordered him to go and find
Out what was wrong with Mordecai

[Pre-Chorus]
He went to the city square
Before the gate of the king
Mordecai told him everything
That had happened to him

[Chorus]
The silver for the Jews to die
A copy of the decree
Go to the king and plead
Beg for her people

[Verse]
Hathach returned with the words
He reported all to Esther
She told him to take the reply
Back to Mordecai again

[Pre-Chorus]
All the servants know the law
If you go in unsummoned
There is but one law is death
Unless the king extends his hand

[Chorus]
The silver for the Jews to die
A copy of the decree
Go to the king and plead
Beg for her people

[Verse]
Esther had not been called
For thirty days now
But Mordecai sent back his charge
Do not think you will escape

[Bridge]
If you keep silent now
Deliverance comes from another place
You and your father's house will perish
Who knows what is to be

[Outro]
Perhaps you have come to the throne
For just such a time as this
